# Jubilees Chapter 6 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QJub (Hebrew fragments) | **Section:** Noah's Offerings; Covenant; Blood Prohibition; 364-Day Calendar

---

**6:1** On the new moon of the third month Noah went out of the ark. He built an altar on that mountain and called upon the name of the LORD, saying: "You, O LORD God of our ancestors, do not turn your face away from the children of Noah and from the seed of Shem; and may Japheth not be far from you. May God dwell in the tents of Shem, and may Canaan be his servant and a servant to his brothers."

**6:2** On that day he offered a burnt offering to the LORD: from among the clean animals and clean birds, a he-goat as a sin offering, a calf, a sheep, a dove, and a turtledove as burnt offerings, together with salt.

**6:3** He offered these upon the altar with the salt and poured over them a fourth of a hin of oil.

**6:4** Noah offered it as a sweet-smelling offering; it was acceptable before the LORD, and the LORD smelled the sweet fragrance.

**6:5** The LORD said to him: "Build altars in every place where you settle, and consecrate them, and the sweet fragrance will be acceptable to me throughout all generations, for I shall not create the earth again."

**6:6** "But take care not to eat any blood, for this reason I command you: 'You shall not eat the blood of any creature — neither of beasts nor of birds nor of any creature that moves on the earth, in the water, or in the air.'"

**6:7** "For if you eat blood it will be a curse upon you; and everyone who eats the blood of any creature — for the life is in the blood — shall die."

**6:8** "And whoever sheds human blood, by a human shall his blood be shed, for God made humanity in his own image."

**6:9** "As for you, be fruitful and multiply on the earth."

**6:10** Noah and his sons swore that they would eat no blood in any flesh, and he made a covenant before the LORD God forever throughout all generations of the earth in this month.

**6:11** For this reason God spoke to you that you should make a covenant with the children of Israel in this month upon the mountain with an oath, and that you should sprinkle blood upon them because of all the words of the covenant which the LORD made with them forever.

**6:12** This testimony is written concerning you, that you should observe it continually: you shall not eat on any day the blood of beast, bird, or cattle throughout all the days of the earth, and the man who eats the blood of beast, bird, or cattle — he and his seed shall be cut off from under heaven.

**6:13** Therefore command the children of Israel to eat no blood, so that their names and their descendants may endure before the LORD our God continually.

**6:14** For this law has no limit of days — it is eternal. They shall observe it throughout their generations, so that they may continually make supplication before the LORD our God with the blood they offer on the altar. Every day that they offer to him there will be atonement, because we do not eat the blood of beast, bird, or cattle.

**6:15** Behold, I ordained and gave the commandment to the children of Noah and to all flesh: do not cover the blood, but pour it upon the earth and cover it with dust.

**6:16** For this reason I commanded the children of Israel: every hunter among them who hunts beast or bird or anything in the water shall pour out its blood and cover it with earth.

**6:17** For the life is in the blood, and I commanded the children of Israel not to cover the blood, but to pour it upon the earth and cover it with dust; for this is the law and ordinance commanded to the children of Israel.

**6:18** This law has no limit of days — it is eternal. They shall observe it throughout their generations, so that they may make supplication before the LORD our God with the blood they offer.

**6:19** In this third month, in the first week of it, before the days of Noah, this covenant was ordained — that there would be a flood in the year the covenant was broken. For Noah had sworn by the throne of the LORD that he would not alter this covenant.

**6:20** Therefore, on the new moon of the third month, God commanded them to fast and to humble themselves, and to offer a burnt offering to the LORD. For this was the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of First Fruits — this feast was twofold and of a double nature, according to what is written and engraved on the heavenly tablets.

**6:21** For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tablets that they should celebrate the Feast of Weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant annually.

**6:22** This entire festival was observed in heaven from the day of creation until the days of Noah — twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years. Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, until the day of Noah's death. After Noah's death his sons abandoned it until the days of Abraham, and they ate blood.

**6:23** Abraham alone kept it, and Isaac and Jacob and his children maintained it until your days. But in your days the children of Israel forgot it until you celebrated it anew on this mountain.

**6:24** Therefore command the children of Israel to observe this festival in all their generations as a commandment: one day a year in this month they shall celebrate the feast, for it is the Feast of Weeks and the Feast of First Fruits.

**6:25** This entire festival was twofold and of a double nature: the first fruits of the harvest and the renewal of the covenant — prescribed for it each year — so that Israel should remember and renew the covenant in the third month every year.

**6:26** The whole number of the days of the year is three hundred and sixty-four days. When divided into weeks they are fifty-two complete weeks, and the remainder of the year — when its days have been reckoned — is three hundred and sixty-four.

**6:27** The commandment is ordained and engraved on the heavenly tablets to keep the testimony of the years from this. There is no neglecting this commandment for a single year or from year to year.

**6:28** Command the children of Israel to observe the years according to this reckoning — three hundred and sixty-four days. These constitute a complete year, and they shall not disturb its appointed times from their days or their feasts; for everything will come about according to their testimony, and they will leave out no day nor disturb any feast.

**6:29** But if they neglect and do not observe them according to his commandment, then they will disrupt all their seasons and the years will be dislodged from their proper order, and they will neglect their ordinances.

**6:30** All the children of Israel will forget and will not find the reckoning of the years, and will forget the new moons, the seasons, and the sabbaths, and they will go wrong regarding the entire order of the years.

**6:31** For I know and from this time I will declare it to you, that the children of Israel will neglect this reckoning of the year and will err in their intercalation. They will adopt what has been prescribed for the Gentiles, and they will go astray regarding new moons, times, and sabbaths, and they will eat all manner of blood with all manner of flesh.

**6:32** And there will be people who will observe the moon — how it disrupts the seasons and comes before its time by two days — and these will reckon the years by it, apart from this reckoning.

**6:33** For I know they are contentious and will say: "The moon is the timepiece." They will disrupt and lead astray those who count the years correctly, and those people will be regarded as erroneous.

**6:34** And all of them will call the seven weeks "Weeks of Years" — that is, "Jubilees" — seven times over.

**6:35** And herewith the account of the division of the days is concluded.

---
*SOPHIA notes: Consensus follows LOGOS throughout. "Feast of Weeks" and "Feast of First Fruits" (v.20) retained as proper festival names. The solar calendar polemic (vv.26-34) preserved in full with its technical vocabulary. "Atonement" (v.14) used where EMET has "pardon" and LOGOS has the same — LOGOS/consensus is consistent.*
